name: Shell
notes: Shell reports an 'Operating profit' line only under US GAAP (2001-2003, quality reported: before interest and other income, interest expense and currency exchange gains/losses, includes the Group's share of associates' operating profit). Under IFRS (2004+) no such line exists, so operatingIncome is derived (quality estimated) as income before taxation plus interest expense less interest and other income (2006-2008: plus net finance costs and other (income)/expense), which gives the same scope. It includes the share of profit of equity-accounted investments (after tax and interest under IFRS, so 2003->2004 is not strictly comparable) and excludes disposal gains booked in interest and other income. Royal Dutch/Shell Group (2001-2004 via Royal Dutch Petroleum filings), Royal Dutch Shell plc 2005-2021, Shell plc 2022+. Revenue: 2001-2003 US GAAP 'Net proceeds' (sales proceeds less sales taxes/excise duties); 2004+ IFRS 'Revenue' (net of sales taxes). 2001 as first reported in Q4 2002 results (later 20-F restated 2001 revenue lower, 122,453); 2002 and 2003 as restated in the following year's Q4 results; 2004-2005 IFRS from 20-F FY2005; 2012 as first reported (later restated for IAS 19R: income before taxation 50,512); 2014 income before taxation was later restated to 28,314. 2000 omitted: no fetched source gave Group figures. FY ends Dec 31.
